plugins.name: AI Receptionist
plugins.description: Answers your business phone's calls and texts with OAIY's agent, through a Bluetooth adapter paired with the phone. Brings the phone and the Calendar to OAIY.
plugins.needs: A Bluetooth USB adapter, and the phone to pair with it.

source.note: The AI Receptionist cannot be downloaded from here yet. If you have its plugin from Aokie, unzip it and choose the folder it makes.
